title: feuilleea cumingii
intro: Feuilleea cumingii, commonly known as Philippine ginseng, is a type of flowering plant in the family Celastraceae. It is native to the Philippines and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and boosting the immune system. Bioactive constituents found in Feuilleea cumingii include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
